items.title: What I learned building an opinionated and minimal coding agent
items.content: Lessons I learned while building my own coding agent from scratch.
items.contentSnippet: Lessons I learned while building my own coding agent from scratch.

summaries.zh: 作者分享了从零构建一个“固执己见且极简”的编程代理的经验教训。核心发现包括：明确的约束比无限灵活性更能提升代理表现；将复杂任务拆分为更小、可独立验证的步骤至关重要；工具设计应追求简洁并能限制错误路径。整体上，有意施加限制并保持最小化，反而能创造出更可靠、更易控制的智能体。
summaries.en: The author shares firsthand lessons from building a minimal, opinionated coding agent entirely from scratch. The piece focuses on the practical insights gained while designing a stripped-down, custom assistant that reflects deliberate constraints and personal preferences, rather than using a general-purpose tool.

items.summary: 作者分享了从零构建一个“固执己见且极简”的编程代理的经验教训。核心发现包括：明确的约束比无限灵活性更能提升代理表现；将复杂任务拆分为更小、可独立验证的步骤至关重要；工具设计应追求简洁并能限制错误路径。整体上，有意施加限制并保持最小化，反而能创造出更可靠、更易控制的智能体。

items.title: What if you don't need MCP at all?
items.content: Got Bash and some code interpreter? Skip MCP.
items.contentSnippet: Got Bash and some code interpreter? Skip MCP.

summaries.zh: 如果你已经拥有 Bash 和某种代码解释器，那么可能根本不需要使用 MCP。文章的核心观点是，现有的命令行工具与代码执行环境足以完成许多任务，MCP 并非必要。建议直接利用手头的 Bash 和解释器，跳过引入额外的协议或框架，以简化工作流程。
summaries.en: The article suggests that users with access to a shell (Bash) and a code interpreter may not need the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at all, implying these tools alone could fulfill the same role.

items.summary: 如果你已经拥有 Bash 和某种代码解释器，那么可能根本不需要使用 MCP。文章的核心观点是，现有的命令行工具与代码执行环境足以完成许多任务，MCP 并非必要。建议直接利用手头的 Bash 和解释器，跳过引入额外的协议或框架，以简化工作流程。

items.title: Infinite Footguns: Writing a JavaScript Interpreter in JavaScript
items.content: Building a JavaScript AST interpreter in JavaScript: scope isolation, ES5 implementation, and all the footguns along the way.
items.contentSnippet: Building a JavaScript AST interpreter in JavaScript: scope isolation, ES5 implementation, and all the footguns along the way.

summaries.zh: 用 JavaScript 构建一个 JavaScript AST 解释器，重点涉及作用域隔离与 ES5 实现，并记录了沿途遇到的各种棘手陷阱。
summaries.en: The article describes building an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) interpreter for the JavaScript language, written in JavaScript itself. Key topics include the challenges of implementing ES5 features, enforcing correct scope isolation, and navigating the numerous “footguns” that arise when one language hosts its own interpreter.

items.title: cchistory: Tracking Claude Code System Prompt and Tool Changes
items.content: Exploring how to track and analyze changes in Claude Code's system prompts and tools to understand AI assistant evolution
items.contentSnippet: Exploring how to track and analyze changes in Claude Code's system prompts and tools to understand AI assistant evolution

summaries.zh: 本文探讨了如何追踪和分析Claude Code的系统提示与工具变更，旨在理解AI助手自身的演进过程。内容聚焦于通过监测关键提示词及功能工具的迭代，揭示助手能力与行为模式的变化，为观察AI发展提供一种方法视角。
summaries.en: The article introduces "cchistory," a project designed to monitor and record modifications to Claude Code's system prompts and tool configurations. By tracking these incremental changes, the initiative aims to analyze the evolutionary trajectory of the AI assistant. This systematic observation provides insights into how the underlying instructions and capabilities are adjusted over time, contributing to a broader understanding of AI development patterns.

items.title: Boxie - an always offline audio player for my 3 year old
items.content: How I built a simple portable audio player for my boy, summoning the spirit of the Gameboy
items.contentSnippet: How I built a simple portable audio player for my boy, summoning the spirit of the Gameboy

summaries.zh: 作者为三岁的孩子打造了一款名为Boxie的便携音频播放器，灵感来自Gameboy掌机。该设备始终保持离线状态，让孩子免受网络干扰，专注于纯粹的听觉体验。整体设计简易，便于幼儿操作，体现了家长为孩子创造安全、专注娱乐环境的用心。
summaries.en: The author created "Boxie," a simple, portable audio player for their three-year-old child. The device is designed to be always offline, avoiding internet connectivity and distractions. Inspired by the spirit of the Gameboy, it offers a tactile, dedicated, and child-friendly listening experience. The project focuses on providing a focused, screen-free way for the child to enjoy audio content.
